notes.title: Version 1.0.7
notes.content:
- Added German language
- Improved the Italian translations
- Added achievements in Italian

- Added the possibility to directly equip when you pickup an item.
From now : Left click => Take; Right click => Equip.
It avoids to have to pass by the inventory window each time you pick up an item.
- Improved the gamepad UI elements
- Reduced the life and mana recovery time to avoid the scheme : Fight => Sleep
- Improved the pathfinding code to greatly decrease the processor usage
- Updated the demo version
- Corrected minor bugs

tags.feature: - Added German language
- Added achievements in Italian
- Added the possibility to directly equip when you pickup an item.

notes.title: Quick update : Spanish translation improvement
notes.content:
The Spanish translation was updated and the achievements in Spanish were added.

This is the right occasion to thank those who translated the game :

[b]Baleful[/b] in Russian 
[b]Morgwenn[/b] in Italian 
[b]Sheen[/b] in Spanish  

They wanted to propose their help to increase the Indie scene, to be a part of it.

As they already know, I will never thank them enough, it represents days of work, and it is far from easy.

From my point of view these people are ... Wow!!

Thank you again buddies...
Cédric

notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
- Now when you pick up an item and that the corresponding equipment slot is empty it will auto equip it. That will make the beginning of the game a lot simplier.
- New messages appear in specific situations
- Few error messages are more explicit
- Now gamepad assignments are more universal
- Modified the freeze effect to be longer

- Corrected few slowdowns that happened on low configuration
- Corrected few minor bugs
